description: Defines the CalendarData class used for calendar event management within the Fineract project, including properties, constructors, and utility methods.

classes.name: CalendarData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing calendar event details, including properties for event timing, recurrence, reminders, and options for UI templates.

methods.name: importInstanceNoRepeatsOnDay
methods.description: Creates a CalendarData instance for a non-repeating event without specific day-of-week repeats.

methods.name: importInstanceWithRepeatsOnDay
methods.description: Creates a CalendarData instance for a repeating event with specific day-of-week repeats.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a CalendarData object with all properties specified.

methods.name: withRecurringDates
methods.description: Returns a new CalendarData instance with updated recurring dates and recent meeting date.

methods.name: withRecentEligibleMeetingDate
methods.description: Returns a new CalendarData instance with an updated recent eligible meeting date.

methods.name: sensibleDefaultsForNewCalendarCreation
methods.description: Provides default values for creating a new calendar event.

methods.name: withTemplateOptions
methods.description: Returns a new CalendarData instance with updated template options for UI.

methods.name: isStartDateBeforeOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the start date is before or equal to a given date.

methods.name: isEndDateAfterOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the end date is after or equal to a given date.

methods.name: isBetweenStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Checks if a date falls within the start and end date range.

methods.name: isValidRecurringDate
methods.description: Determines if a date is valid for recurrence based on recurrence rules.
